name: libvirt (in Docker)
description: Installs the distribution's libvirt daemon, QEMU, UEFI firmware, virsh, and virt-install, and starts the daemon at every container start in a privileged dev container, so the remote user runs virtual machines inside the container, with KVM when the host offers it; guest definitions and disks persist in two named volumes.

defaultNetwork.description: Start libvirt's default NAT network (virbr0, 192.168.122.0/24) at every container start.

swtpm.description: Install the software TPM emulator swtpm and its setup tools, for guests that need a TPM.
